LanguageData.MilitaryStances.Settings.ActivatedDesc: Master toggle to enable or disable all Military Stances features.
LanguageData.MilitaryStances.Settings.ShowButtonsDesc: Toggle whether the Body Stance and Weapon Stance gizmo buttons are shown on selected pawns.
LanguageData.MilitaryStances.Settings.ProneAffectsMov: When enabled, pawns in the Prone pose move at their crawling speed instead of normal movement speed.
LanguageData.MilitaryStances.Settings.ProneWeaponBehi: Render weapon underneath pawn when Prone
When enabled, sets the carried weapon render layer behind/underneath the pawn while in the Prone stance.
LanguageData.MilitaryStances.Settings.ProneWeaponOffs: Adjust weapon position offset when Prone
Shifts the held weapon off the prone body centerline and adjusts Weapon Stance alignment so the weapon remains clearly positioned.
LanguageData.MilitaryStances.Settings.ProneWeaponSide: Lateral/chest-side offset applied when aiming prone (and for North/South carried stances) so the weapon is not centered directly on the head/body.
LanguageData.MilitaryStances.Settings.ProneWeaponForw: Forward offset along the prone facing or aim direction so the weapon sits ahead of the torso/head.
LanguageData.MilitaryStances.Settings.ProneWeaponStan: Vertical offset adjustment for East/West Weapon Stances (Normal / High / Low) while prone.
LanguageData.MilitaryStances.Settings.WeaponReadyIncl: Weapon Stance also affects melee weapons
By default, Weapon Stance only affects ranged weapons. Enable this to apply ready poses to melee weapons as well.
LanguageData.MilitaryStances.Settings.IgnoreEquippedA: Ignore weapon equippedAngleOffset during Weapon Stance

Normally, equippedAngleOffset calibrates diagonally-drawn weapon textures (such as melee weapons) so they align properly before rotating. Enable this if you use modded weapons whose horizontal textures use equippedAngleOffset as a custom carry tilt.
LanguageData.MilitaryStances.PlaySettingToggle: Toggle visibility of Military Stances gizmo buttons.
LanguageData.MilitaryStances.ToggleBodyStanceDesc: Toggle whether custom body stance is enabled for this pawn.
LanguageData.MilitaryStances.ChangeBodyStanceDesc: Select the body stance (Stand / Prone) for this pawn.
LanguageData.MilitaryStances.ToggleWeaponStanceDesc: Toggle whether custom weapon stance is enabled while drafted.
LanguageData.MilitaryStances.ChangeWeaponReadyStanceD: Select the weapon ready stance (Normal / High / Low) for this pawn.
LanguageData.MilitaryStances.UI.EnableBodyStancesFirs: Disabled: Enable Body Stances toggle on the left first.
LanguageData.MilitaryStances.UI.EnableWeaponStancesFi: Disabled: Enable Weapon Stances toggle on the left first.
